  mutate(
    launch_date_parsed = coalesce(
      lubridate::ymd(launch_date, quiet = TRUE),
      lubridate::mdy(launch_date, quiet = TRUE)
    )
  ) |>
  select(coin_id, coin_name, launch_date, launch_date_parsed) |>
  arrange(launch_date_parsed)
```

## Exercise 9

  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = price_usd)) +

```

## Data Preparation — Exercises 5, 6, 10, 11, 12, 13 & 14

```{r}
#| cache: true

prices <- open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  collect()

metadata <- open_dataset("data/coin_metadata.parquet") |>
  collect()

categories <- open_dataset("data/categories.parquet") |>
  collect()

crypto <- prices |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  left_join(select(categories, -description), by = "category_id") |>
  mutate(date = ymd(date_raw))
```



## Exercise 18 — Crypto Market Share and Major Events

```{r}
# Calculate market cap by category and date
market_share <- crypto |>
  group_by(date, category_id) |>
  summarise(
    market_cap = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(date) |>
  mutate(
    share = market_cap / sum(market_cap)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# Order categories by their typical market share
category_order <- market_share |>
  group_by(category_id) |>
  summarise(
    typical_share = median(share, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(typical_share)) |>
  pull(category_id)

market_share <- market_share |>
  mutate(
    category = factor(category_id, levels = rev(category_order))
  )

# Plot
ggplot(market_share, aes(x = date, y = share, fill = category)) +
  geom_area(position = "fill") +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = as.Date("2022-05-07"),
    xmax = as.Date("2022-05-12"),
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    fill = "red",
    alpha = 0.15
  ) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = as.Date("2022-11-08"),
    xmax = as.Date("2022-11-11"),
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    fill = "red",
    alpha = 0.15
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = as.Date("2022-05-09"),
    y = 0.95,
    label = "Luna/UST Crash",
    angle = 90,
    size = 3
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = as.Date("2022-11-09"),
    y = 0.95,
    label = "FTX Collapse",
    angle = 90,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "viridis") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Cryptocurrency Market Share by Category",
    subtitle = "Daily percentage of total crypto market capitalization held by each category",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Share of Total Market Cap",
    fill = "Crypto Category",
    caption = "Source: Course cryptocurrency datasets (daily prices, coin metadata and categories)."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 8)
  )
```
